name: Jesus' Life and Teaching Quiz Bank
summary: Reusable quiz questions from the Jesus' Life and Teaching lesson pack.
kid_summary: Questions from Jesus' Life and Teaching.

questions.question: Where was Jesus born?
This lesson teaches that jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised.
Where did Mary and Joseph find Jesus?
This lesson teaches that jesus grew in wisdom and knew He belonged to His Father's work.
Who baptized Jesus?
This lesson teaches that jesus obeyed the Father and was publicly shown as God's beloved Son.
What did Jesus use to answer temptation?
This lesson teaches that jesus answered temptation with God's Word and remained faithful.
What did Jesus say to the fishermen?
This lesson teaches that following Jesus means listening when He calls and learning His way.
Who taught the Beatitudes?
This lesson teaches that jesus teaches that God's kingdom values humility, mercy, purity, and peace.
Who taught this prayer?
This lesson teaches that jesus teaches us to pray with trust, worship, daily dependence, forgiveness, and help.
Where did the wise builder build?
This lesson teaches that wisdom means hearing Jesus' words and putting them into practice.
What did Jesus calm?
This lesson teaches that jesus has authority over creation and cares for fearful disciples.
Who helped the hurt man?
This lesson teaches that love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.
What did the father do when the son returned?
This lesson teaches that god welcomes repentant sinners with mercy and joy.
What did the seed picture?
This lesson teaches that god's Word should be received with a heart that listens and grows.
What food did the boy have?
This lesson teaches that jesus can use small gifts and provide more than enough.
Who rescued Peter?
This lesson teaches that faith looks to Jesus when fear feels bigger than courage.
Who did Jesus raise from the tomb?
This lesson teaches that jesus has power over death and cares when people grieve.
Why did Zacchaeus climb a tree?
This lesson teaches that jesus seeks and saves lost people, and His grace changes lives.
Who told His disciples to remember Him?
This lesson teaches that jesus gave His followers a meal to remember His saving death.
Where did Jesus pray before the cross?
This lesson teaches that jesus obeyed the Father even when the path was painful.
Where did Jesus die?
This lesson teaches that jesus gave His life to save sinners.
What did Mary find at the tomb?
This lesson teaches that jesus rose from the dead, giving His people hope and joy.
